title: Say
description: say: what the user said at the node. The frame's id is the id of the turn; her answer comes in frames that refer to it.

text.description: The words of the user. May be empty (since 1.11) when `images` has an image.

speak.description: Speak the reply too, in audio frames (default true).

reasoning.description: Send the thinking of the model too (default false).

withEvents.description: Take along what waits to be told to her (since 1.5: the changes of her parts sent just before): one turn about these words and those events, with this frame's id (default false).

images.description: Images to look at with the words (since 1.11): the ids `POST /api/v1/jois/{id}/images` gave, in this order, at most 4. An `error` frame `no_vision` when she cannot look at images.
